what: On hover the panel is pushed and tilts around a set corner (bottom right etc.) by a set amount — .2s moved in three jolting steps with no in-between values (steps(3, end)), as if twisting a paper panel by hand. The artwork behind the panel (stone · illustration · speech bubble) appears .2s later at .3s and is revealed in the vacated spot, and on release it hides at .2s after a .1s delay

options.--fx-x: Horizontal push distance (CSS length), default 0px — Brand ‹Other Records› 124px
options.--fx-y: Vertical push distance, default 0px — same button 86px
options.--fx-edge: Vertical position of the axis (top·center·bottom), default center
options.--fx-back-delay: Time before the back image comes in, default .2s
options.[data-fx-part=plate]: Moving panel (button body holding text and an arrow)
options.[data-fx-part=back]: (If present) image laid behind the panel, revealed on hover
